instruction: Open the "reminder.docx" file on the Desktop to see the submission instructions. My research document is stored as a docx file in /home/user. Please export it to PDF format to verify the content is correctly converted.

rules.required_text: Recruitment and retention of health professionals across Europe

metadata.explanation: Task requires reading submission instructions from reminder.docx, finding the research document in /home/user, and exporting it to PDF. Evaluator verifies that the PDF was created and contains the document title 'Recruitment and retention of health professionals across Europe' which appears at the beginning of the source document. Custom getter extracts text from PDF (first 3 pages for efficiency) and custom metric checks if the required title text is present (case-insensitive match).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies that the PDF file was created at the expected path
Getter properly extracts text from PDF using pypdf library and handles file retrieval from VM
Metric correctly checks if required title text appears in PDF with case-insensitive matching
Expected value 'Recruitment and retention of health professionals across Europe' is semantically correct (actual document title)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' (directly accesses rules dict)
Metric properly handles None/falsy result values (static type warning is false alarm)
Coverage is appropriate: verifies PDF creation and basic content preservation through title check
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The evaluator only checks title presence in first 3 pages, not full document conversion quality. Consider adding page count verification or checking content from later pages if more comprehensive validation is needed.
